description: Vehicle safety brief (bundle) — One call: LOW / MODERATE / HIGH safety concern level for a make, model and year. Fuses NHTSA recalls (with do-not-drive warnings), owner complaint totals with crashes, fires, injuries and deaths, top problem components, and crash-test star ratings. For agents screening a used car before buying, listing or financing. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
